comparisons.peer_summary: The AMD Instinct family (MI200, MI300, MI325 series) utilizes CDNA architecture to address AI training, inferencing, and scientific computing demands.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies disclose the foundation of their accelerated computing platforms focusing on GPUs for AI training and inferencing. NVIDIA frames this as an 'accelerated computing platform' where GPUs are the core, expanded recently to include DPUs and CPUs, whereas AMD explicitly details the 'Instinct family' of GPU accelerators based on CDNA architecture. Both identify AI training and inferencing as primary demand drivers for these hardware products, though NVIDIA emphasizes the platform ecosystem (servers, cloud providers) and AMD specifies the product series (MI200, MI300, MI325).

sentences.text: At the foundation of the NVIDIA accelerated computing platform are our GPUs, which excel at parallel workloads such as the training and inferencing of neural networks.
Beyond GPUs, our data center platform expanded to include DPUs in fiscal year 2022 and CPUs in fiscal year 2024.
Our AMD Instinct family of GPU accelerator products, including AMD Instinct MI200, MI300 and MI325 series, are based on AMD CDNA™ architecture.
AMD Instinct accelerators are designed to address the growing demand for AI training and inferencing and exascale-class scientific computing.
